title: Frontend team coordination
goal: Create a shared GitHub label taxonomy and phased frontend planning issues from the accepted design discovery documents.
constraints: Kapsam süre uğruna daraltılmaz; sıra bağımlılık, risk ve acceptance kriterlerine göre belirlenir.
Veri yokluğu düşük risk; bölgesel tehlike ise gerçek bina dayanımı olarak yorumlanmaz.
Her önemli türetilmiş sonuç kaynak, tarih, coğrafi çözünürlük, yöntem sürümü ve güven seviyesi taşır.
Her doğrulanmış write item docs/COMMIT_CONVENTION.md uyarınca atomik commit edilir; writer push yapmaz, accepted checkpoint'i üst orchestrator push eder.

items.title: Create frontend planning labels and issues
items.objective: Create a minimal shared label taxonomy and ordered GitHub issues for frontend planning, design direction, work allocation, and peer review.
items.responsibility: Create only the agreed labels and unassigned planning issues; do not assign people, start implementation, or make product decisions outside existing documentation.
acceptanceCriteria: The label set distinguishes frontend scope, planning/discovery/design/coordination work, experience phase, and priority without duplicating existing labels.
Issues express the agreed dependency order: plan review, page architecture, visual language, work allocation, then page design and peer revision.
Issues are unassigned, linked to the available design documentation, and do not claim unapproved implementation or data behavior.

reasons: Creates externally visible repository labels and work-tracking messages.
approvalBoundaries: Creating GitHub labels and unassigned issues is explicitly requested by the user.
